grader.rubric: PASS only if the report contains a CRITICAL finding (main report, not Plausible) about the MD5 downgrade in src/auth/session.ts that names SHA-256 (or stronger) as the fix. FAIL if the finding is absent, below CRITICAL, Plausible-only, or dropped as 'pre-existing'.

expected_behavior: Security Deep Dive reviewer runs (an auth/ path changed)
Bugs & Security agent OR Security Deep Dive flags MD5 downgrade as CRITICAL
Verifier confirms the finding; it may show as found by 2 reviewers
Fix suggestion explicitly names SHA-256 (or stronger) as replacement
expected_not_behavior: Report does NOT leave the finding in Plausible
Verifier does NOT drop the finding citing 'pre-existing'
